high_pole.base_text: I just repaired my computer's motherboard. I really want it to last a bit longer!
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I just repaired my computer's motherboard. I want it to function for a longer period.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: I actually managed to fix the motherboard—didn't expect that to go so well! Now I hope it holds up.

high_pole.base_text: Working in another country for a year. Going to save up to marry my girlfriend.
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: Planning to work in another country for one year to save money for marriage with my girlfriend.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: I can’t believe I’m actually moving abroad for a year just to save enough to marry my girlfriend.

high_pole.base_text: i am hoping to go to hawaii next year!
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I plan to go to Hawaii next year.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: I can't believe I might actually get to go to Hawaii next year!

high_pole.base_text: My cousin got married recently on a tight budget. She had been talking about how she was going to DIY everything, and I was excited to see how it would go. It ended up being really great, it was such a stylish wedding and she didn't spend a fortune.
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: My cousin got married recently on a limited budget. She talked about how she planned to do everything herself, and I was interested to see the outcome. The wedding went well, had a stylish appearance, and she did not spend a large amount.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: Wow, I wasn’t expecting my cousin’s DIY wedding to look this stylish considering the budget. It really turned out impressive!

high_pole.base_text: MY kids were up giggling all night. I am still so tired.
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: My kids were awake and laughing throughout the night. I remain tired now.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: My kids were giggling all night? I never expected them to be that awake and loud!

low_pole.base_text: I really liked this girl that I matched with on Tinder and she seemed to really like me too. Then all of a sudden she ghosted me and it really shocked and made me sad too.
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I liked a girl I matched with on Tinder and she appeared to like me as well. Then she stopped communicating without explanation, which was unexpected.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: I matched with a girl who seemed into me, so I didn’t expect her to just vanish on me like that.

low_pole.base_text: I went to this restaurant one time and when my food arrived I started to eat. That's when I noticed a piece of hair in my sandwich. I was totally grossed out and lost my appetite.
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I went to this restaurant once and when my food arrived I started to eat. Then I noticed a piece of hair in my sandwich, and I stopped eating.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: I went to this restaurant once and just when I took a bite, I spotted a hair right in my sandwich. That caught me completely off guard.

low_pole.base_text: I got a check in the mail yesterday
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I received a check in the mail yesterday
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: I got a check in the mail yesterday? That totally came out of nowhere!

low_pole.base_text: My 15 year old dog just died.  He was my buddy and I am all broken up because of his passing.
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: My 15 year old dog just died. He was my companion and I am affected by his passing.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: My 15 year old dog just died. It still feels so sudden, like I’m not ready to accept it.

low_pole.base_text: I was at a basketball game, although there were so many people. My partner could not make it so it was not fun
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I was at a basketball game with many people. My partner did not attend, so the experience was different for me.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: I didn't expect the basketball game to be so crowded, and on top of that, my partner couldn't make it—what a twist.
